headline.zh: 为尽职调查构建财务数据工作流
headline.en: Build Financial Data Workflow for Due Diligence

scenario.zh: 某私募基金正在评估一家 SaaS 公司，需要快速分析其三年收入增长趋势与毛利率变化
scenario.en: A PE fund is evaluating a SaaS company and needs to quickly analyze its three-year revenue growth trend and gross margin changes

instruction.zh: 决定如何获取目标公司的财务数据
instruction.en: Decide how to retrieve target company financial data

label.zh: 自动提取公开披露文件

output.zh: 已连接 SEC 数据流，三年季报数据结构化完成，字段映射准确
output.en: Connected SEC data stream, three years of quarterly data structured with accurate field mapping

label.zh: 导入客户提供的电子表格

output.zh: 已解析上传文件，识别出收入与成本科目，但部分科目需人工确认
output.en: Parsed uploaded file, identified revenue and cost accounts but some items need manual confirmation

instruction.zh: 设定工作流如何处理财务指标计算
instruction.en: Define how workflow handles financial metric calculations

label.zh: 使用行业标准毛利率公式

output.zh: 工作流按 SaaS 行业惯例计算，已排除一次性项目，趋势线清晰
output.en: Workflow applies SaaS conventions, excluded one-time items, trend line is clear

label.zh: 自定义调整项处理逻辑

output.zh: 工作流将股权激励成本单独标注，毛利率计算增加了可比性
output.en: Workflow labeled equity compensation separately, margin calculation gained comparability

instruction.zh: 对比不同质量检查策略的发现
instruction.en: Compare findings from different quality check strategies

output.zh: 标记了 Q2 2022 收入环比异常波动，未深入核查原因
output.en: Flagged Q2 2022 sequential revenue anomaly but did not investigate cause

output.zh: 发现该季度确认了大额年度合同，并与现金流数据相互印证
output.en: Found large annual contract recognized that quarter, corroborated by cash flow data

instruction.zh: 确认最终交付的分析成果

output.zh: 生成三年趋势图表与关键比率表格，适合投委会快速浏览
output.en: Generated three-year trend charts and key ratio tables, suitable for quick IC review

output.zh: 输出可追溯到原始披露的动态模型，支持情景假设调整
output.en: Delivered dynamic model traceable to source filings, supports scenario adjustments

takeaway.zh: Daloopa 的 AI 工作流将财务数据提取、验证与分析自动化，让金融团队专注于投资判断而非数据整理
takeaway.en: Daloopa's AI workflows automate financial data extraction, validation and analysis, letting finance teams focus on investment judgment rather than data wrangling

initial.zh: 目标公司：CloudTech Inc | 分析重点：2021-2023 收入与毛利率 | 关注点：增长可持续性
initial.en: Target: CloudTech Inc | Focus: 2021-2023 Revenue & Gross Margin | Key: Growth Sustainability
